name: Chronic kidney disease (early stages, G1-G3b)
surveyQuestion: Do you have any of these health conditions? (select all that apply) -> Kidney disease (CKD). Check question: Has a doctor told you that you have chronic kidney disease, or that your eGFR is below 60 or there is protein (albumin) in your urine? Yes, stage 1-3 / Yes, stage 4-5 or on dialysis or kidney transplant (out of scope: show doctor-only message, no targets) / Yes, but I do not know my stage / Not sure / No. Follow-ups: latest eGFR, ACR, serum potassium and phosphate (optional); on water pills, ACE inhibitor, ARB, spironolactone or SGLT2 inhibitor (Yes/No/Not sure; app never comments on medicines); has your doctor given you a fluid, potassium, phosphorus or protein limit (Yes with numbers / No)

waterMl.notes: No automatic water target for CKD. Early CKD (G1-G3) usually needs no fluid limit (NKF: may not need to limit fluid), but FitPlate neither pushes a higher target nor sets a limit; any fluid restriction comes only from the nephrologist, especially with swelling, heart failure, diuretics or advanced CKD. If a doctor's limit is entered, it overrides everything. Follow your doctor's advice.

foodsFavour: fresh home-cooked vegetables, fruit and whole grains in the portions your kidney team agrees
dals and legumes in doctor-agreed portions (plant protein)
fresh unprocessed foods cooked with little salt
lemon, jeera, hing, garlic, ginger, coriander and pepper to flavour food instead of salt
plain water as the main drink unless a limit is set
foodsLimit: pickles, papad, namkeen, instant noodles, chips, sauces and packaged foods (sodium and phosphate additives)
cola and processed cheese (phosphate additives; look for PHOS on labels)
low-sodium salt, Tata Salt Lite type salts and any KCl salt substitute
protein powders, high-protein supplements and creatine
herbal, ayurvedic and unlabelled traditional remedies, and painkillers of the NSAID type, unless the nephrologist agrees
large portions of potassium-rich foods only if the doctor has said to limit potassium
